description: Text-only, isolated-session recall evaluation for the limited action catalog.

groups.canonical_label: One exact catalog-label command per action; measures catalog coverage.
groups.natural_request: Human-authored paraphrases; primary natural-language accuracy set.
groups.intent_boundary: Minimal pairs for speech-only, capability, prohibition, greeting, and reaction routing.
groups.unsupported_request: Explicit actions absent from the limited catalog.
